text_markup: The Runner encounters a copy of {card:Loki} while {card:Stick and Poke} is installed and {card:Warden Fatuma} is rezzed. Since {card:Warden Fatuma}'s ability is a static ability, the subroutine it grants is already present when the encounter begins. The Runner resolves the ability from {card:Stick and Poke}, then the Corp resolves the ability from {card:Loki}, choosing a copy of {card:Tithe}. The subroutines on {card:Loki} are, in order: "[sub] Do 1 net damage.", "[sub] Gain 1[c].", "[sub] Do 1 net damage. The Runner draws 1 card.", "[sub] The Runner loses [click].", and "[sub] End the run unless the Runner shuffles all cards from the grip into the stack."
